description: Get the price the checkout will show a new customer, with any evening rate or public voucher it applies. Give `date` and `start_time` (from find_times) for the exact figure for that slot; without them you get the price for that length or job, and the evening rate is described separately. For weekly and every-2-weeks cleans it returns both the prepaid pack of visits (what the checkout starts on) and paying per visit.

frequency.description: Cleaning only: one-time, weekly, or bi-weekly (every 2 weeks).

hours.description: Cleaning only: visit length in hours (see find_services for the lengths we sell, e.g. 2, 3 or 4).

job_type.description: Aircon only: the job, e.g. general_service, chemical_wash, chemical_overhaul (see find_services).

service.description: Required: the service the customer asked for, from find_services. This tool checks a service booked online, one that find_services lists under services: cleaning = home cleaning by the hour (general housekeeping only; a deep clean, spring clean or move-out clean is a different service, under more_services). aircon = aircon servicing, checked here only while find_services lists it under services; while it is under more_services this tool answers with how it is booked.

start_time.description: Start time from find_times, 24-hour HH:MM (e.g. 19:30) or like 7:30 PM.

unit_count.description: Aircon only: number of aircon units (fan coils).

name: get_quote
title: Get the exact price
